\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a judge, elections, a vote, politics, the economy
  \item an actress, a poem, a writer, a painter, a photographer
  \item an adult, an elderly person, a twin, a mother-in-law, a father-in-law
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A judge? (\textbf{o juiz / a juíza}.) Elections? (\textbf{as eleições}.) A vote? (\textbf{o voto}.) Politics? (\textbf{a política}.) The economy? (\textbf{a economia}.) An actress? (\textbf{a atriz}.) A poem? (\textbf{o poema}.) A writer? (\textbf{o escritor / a escritora}.) A painter? (\textbf{o pintor / a pintora}.) A photographer? (\textbf{o fotógrafo}.) An adult? (\textbf{o adulto}.) An elderly person? (\textbf{o idoso}.) A twin? (\textbf{o gémeo / a gémea}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{a sogra}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{o sogro}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
